data.name: Eliezer
data.gender_notes: Eliezer is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Eliezer, which means 'my God is help'. In the Bible, Eliezer is the name of several characters, including a servant of Abraham and a prophet mentioned in 2 Kings. The name has been popular in Christian communities throughout history. The name Eliezer carries the meaning “God is my help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eliezer usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eliezer total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אליעזר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליעזר הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא עזר לי' או 'עזר לי מאלהים'. השם מורכב משני חלקים: 'אל' - שמשמעותו אלוהים, ו'עזר' - שמשמעותו לעזור או לתמוך. השם אליעזר מוזכר בתנ'ך כבן של משה ואשתו ציפורה, וגם כדמות חשובה אחרת בתנ'ך.

in_greek.name: Ἠλιέζερ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἠλιέζερ ὄνομα Ἐβραϊστί, τὸ ὁποῖον σημαίνει 'βοήθεια παρὰ θεοῦ' ἤ 'ὁ θεὸς βοηθεῖ'. Τὸ ὄνομα Ἠλιέζερ εὑρίσκεται καὶ ἐν τῇ Καινῇ Διαθήκη, ὅπου ἀναφέρεται ὡς υἱὸς τοῦ Μωυσέως.

in_latin.name: Eliezer
in_latin.long_meaning: Eliezer nomen Hebraeum, quod significat 'Deus est adiutor meus' vel 'Adiutor a Deo'. Nomen Eliezer invenitur in Veteri Testamento, ubi Eliezer filius Moysis et Ziphorah memoratur.

in_english.name: Eliezer
in_english.meaning: God is my helper or God helps
in_english.long_meaning: Eliezer is a Hebrew name that means 'God is my helper' or 'God helps'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' meaning God and 'ezer' meaning help or helper. Eliezer is a significant name in the Bible, as it was the name of Moses' son with his wife Zipporah, and also the name of another important figure in the Old Testament. The name Eliezer has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person who is blessed with divine assistance and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: Eliezer is a name that has been in continuous use among Christian communities for centuries. It carries a rich cultural heritage, rooted in the biblical stories of ancient Israel and the strong faith of its people. The name is also associated with steadfastness, loyalty, and devotion, as seen in the story of Abraham's servant Eliezer, who was tasked with finding a bride for Isaac and was famous for his faith and integrity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Eliezer carries a deep spiritual significance for Christians, reminding us of the promise that God is always there to help and support us in times of need. It serves as a reminder of the faith and trust that Abraham showed in God, and the unwavering commitment that Eliezer demonstrated to his master. The name Eliezer encourages us to reflect on our own relationship with God and to trust in His divine providence and assistance in all aspects of our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Eliezer, meaning "my God is helper," is a biblical name that reflects the deep trust and reliance on God for assistance and guidance. It is a reminder of God's presence and support in times of need.

biblical_reference.note: Eliezer was the son of Moses and Zipporah

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
